scripts.deploy: pnpm run validate:production-env && pnpm --filter @airux/web run build && wrangler deploy --env production --strict --var "AIRUX_ENVIRONMENT:production" --var "AIRUX_APP_ORIGIN:$AIRUX_APP_ORIGIN" --var "SUPABASE_URL:$SUPABASE_URL" --var "SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:$SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY"
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run validate:production-env && pnpm --filter @airux/web run build && wrangler deploy --env production --strict --dry-run --var "AIRUX_ENVIRONMENT:production" --var "AIRUX_APP_ORIGIN:$AIRUX_APP_ORIGIN" --var "SUPABASE_URL:$SUPABASE_URL" --var "SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:$SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY"
